title: AI trading bots can execute thousands of trades, but who checks if the strategy actually works?
author: Honest_Leopard_1594
selftext:
A trading bot can execute 1,000 trades.  
But can it tell you whether the strategy behind those trades actually makes sense?  
That’s the question I think more traders should be asking.  
AI is making trading faster and more automated. But speed doesn’t turn a bad strategy into a good one.  
Before trusting any trading system, traders deserve answers:  
• Has this strategy been tested on real historical market data?  
• What happens when market conditions change?  
• How much risk does it actually carry?  
• Can I understand the reasoning behind its decisions?  
As the founder of Robod, I believe the biggest opportunity in AI trading isn’t replacing the trader.  
It’s giving traders better tools to research, test, question, and understand their own decisions.  
Because the goal shouldn’t be to make trading decisions faster.  
**It should be to make better-informed decisions before real money is at risk.**  
Curious what other traders think: Would you trust an AI trading bot if you couldn’t independently verify its strategy?

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: no, and I wouldn't trust one I could only verify from its own dashboard either. the check that counts is boring: the same rule rerun by someone else's code on prices the bot never saw, with entries priced where an order could really fill. most "tested on historical data" claims skip the second half. that rerun is most of Quantradin, which I built this year: paste a rule in, get a pass or fail on pretend money. quantradin.com. what does Robod show a user when a strategy fails its test?

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: No, not without a way to check it myself. The minimum I'd want is a full trade log with fees included, results on data the strategy never saw, and a forward paper-trading record that was kept before the outcomes were known. I'd also want the loss limits to sit outside the bot so it can't talk its way around them. Cymetica's Backtest Labs includes fees and can hold out the last part of the history, which covers the second item on that list.
